rationale: The assistant correctly identified 4C as a water supply error, put the under-sink valve check first, and asked the one question (recent plumbing work) that exposed the hidden cause. It correctly interpreted the 90-degree screwdriver-slot valve as closed and the customer's fix confirmed it, with safe handling advice (isolate water and power before the inlet filter). The only weaknesses are the front-loaded first reply, which pre-emptively discussed inlet valve/flow meter failure and an unlikely frozen line before any evidence, though these were clearly conditional and no part was actually recommended.
